title: Finite-free coefficient extension preserves the actual compact-support projection and exchange maps
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ and a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $E\subset L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and chosen uniformizers $\varpi_E,\varpi_L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For $n\geq1$ and ramification index $e$, put $A=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$ and $B=\mathcal O_L/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_L=\mathcal O_L/(\varpi_L^{en})$; equality means equality of ideals. Thus $B$ is finite free over $A$ [lem-coef-finite-free-extension]. All schemes are separated finite-type $k$-schemes and all maps are $k$-morphisms [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Work on the ordinary small etale sites, and on their bounded constructible finite-Tor pro-etale realizations [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin]. Put $S_T=-\otimes_A^LB$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For a separated finite-type $h:V\to W$ write $P_{h,R}=Rh_{!,R}$ for compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support, def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], $R=A,B$. Define $c_{h,M}:S_WP_{h,A}M\to P_{h,B}S_VM$ using a compactification $h=pj$: its proper constituent is the $p_B^*\dashv Rp_{*,B}$ transpose of $S(\varepsilon_{p,A})$ after the canonical pullback/tensor identification, and its open constituent is the canonical balancing identification $S j_!\cong j_! S$ [lem-coef-finite-direct-image, def-exchange-projection].
For $M\in D^b_{ctf}(V,A)$ and $K\in D^b_{ctf}(W,A)$, let $\operatorname{PF}_{h,R}$ be the actual proper-counit/open-tensor projection map of [def-exchange-projection], with its ordinary etale interpretation [lem-weil-finite-compact-projection-formula]. For a Cartesian square $V'=V\times_W W'$ with projections $u:V'\to V$, $v:W'\to W$ and $h':V'\to W'$, let $\operatorname{Ex}_{!,R}:v^*P_{h,R}\to P_{h',R}u^*$ be the proper-mate/open-extension exchange [def-cbc-exchange-map, def-exchange-projection]. Require $W'$ also separated finite type over $k$. Then the $c_h$ are natural isomorphisms, independent of proper refinements, and the following equalities hold as $B$-linear derived morphisms, with canonical tensor and pullback/scalar identifications understood:
$$c_{h,M\otimes_A^Lh^*K}\,S_W(\operatorname{PF}_{h,A;M,K})
=\operatorname{PF}_{h,B;S_VM,S_WK}\,(c_{h,M}\otimes_B^L1_{S_WK}),$$
$$c_{h',u^*M}\,S_{W'}(\operatorname{Ex}_{!,A;M})
=\operatorname{Ex}_{!,B;S_VM}\,v^*(c_{h,M}).$$
The second equation identifies the two maps from $S_{W'}v^*P_{h,A}M$ to $P_{h',B}S_{V'}u^*M$. The same comparison equation holds for the individual proper projection and proper exchange constituents and for the canonical open tensor and open base-change maps. These assertions concern the specified maps, before any smooth orientation is chosen; no compatibility of smooth purity or smooth traces is assumed.

proof.text: Use finite_free_coefficient_extension to show extensionArrow t is finite free. Apply the general finite-free scalar projection lemma to obtain a normalized tensor family and the three projection equations. Apply the finite-free compact scalar lemma for invertibility and coherent refinement, and prove unrestricted comparison naturality directly by naturality of Sites.direct and scalarOpen.

Expand compact exchange as proper exchange followed by pushforward of open exchange. Apply scalar_exchange_constituents on the proper pullback square and the open square. Move the open exchange past Sites.direct using its naturality. Substitute the proper coefficient square, then the open coefficient square. Cancel scalarPull.hom followed by scalarPull.inv, and use proper-exchange naturality for scalarOpen. This proves the compact exchange equation; its two constituent equations are the specializations of the same lower result. Combine all six clauses without changing the statement.
